problem.title: LiTAMIN2 KITTI Odom seq 09 full: the paper's odometry pipeline
problem.question: Does LiTAMIN2 as described in the paper (raw scans voted into 3 m normal distributions, a voxel map of distributions, nearest-distribution pairing, ICP+Cov cost minimised by Newton steps) reproduce the paper's Table III values without loop closure?

variants.label: LiTAMIN2 paper odometry, ICP+Cov, scan-distribution map
variants.intent: Paper pipeline with the full cost (Table III row 'LiTAMIN2 (ICP+Cov)', no loop closure). The map keeps the first scan distribution per 3 m voxel, so the shape term compares like with like.
variants.note: LiTAMIN2 paper odometry (raw scans, 3.0 m distributions, map first, nearest-distribution pairing, ICP+Cov); no GT seed. mean distributions/scan 601.5, mean iterations 11.1
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: LiTAMIN2 paper odometry, ICP only, scan-distribution map
variants.intent: Paper pipeline with the ICP term only (Table III row 'LiTAMIN2 (ICP)'), against the same first-scan-distribution map as paper_icp_cov.
variants.note: LiTAMIN2 paper odometry (raw scans, 3.0 m distributions, map first, nearest-distribution pairing, ICP); no GT seed. mean distributions/scan 601.5, mean iterations 10.8
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.

variants.label: LiTAMIN2 paper odometry, ICP only, aggregated map
variants.intent: ICP term only against map voxels that aggregate every registered point; diverges on the seq 04 highway.
variants.note: LiTAMIN2 paper odometry (raw scans, 3.0 m distributions, map aggregate, nearest-distribution pairing, ICP); no GT seed. mean distributions/scan 601.5, mean iterations 9.4
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.

variants.label: LiTAMIN2 paper odometry, ICP+Cov, aggregated map
variants.intent: Full cost against aggregated map distributions, whose shapes differ from single-scan ones.
variants.note: LiTAMIN2 paper odometry (raw scans, 3.0 m distributions, map aggregate, nearest-distribution pairing, ICP+Cov); no GT seed. mean distributions/scan 601.5, mean iterations 9.6
variants.readability_note: Adds only boolean toggles on top of the stable CLI.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stays inside the stable CLI, but expands the toggle surface.
variants.decision_reason: Useful for comparison, but not strong enough to replace the current default.
